- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Instructions for setting a daily alarm for 7:30 am on weekdays for Android devices:
  1. Open the Clock app.
  2. Tap the "+" icon to create a new alarm.
  3. Set the alarm time to 7:30 am.
  4. Tap "Repeat" and select "Monday" to "Friday."
  5. Choose a ringtone and set the alarm label.
  6. Tap "Save."
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Instructions for setting a daily alarm for 7:30 am on weekdays for iOS devices:
  1. Open the Clock app.
  2. Tap the "+" icon to create a new alarm.
  3. Set the alarm time to 7:30 am.
  4. Tap "Repeat" and select "Monday" to "Friday."
  5. Choose a sound and set the alarm label.
  6. Tap "Save."
